question: Should OpenClaw automatically remove the beta-only Workspaces state for users who manually enabled the experimental plugin, rather than retaining an export, opt-out, or longer deprecation path?
rationale: The repository policy favors removing unshipped experimental compatibility, but this PR deliberately changes the recovery path for beta users and deletes persisted state; that acceptance boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve beta-only removal
options.body: Confirm that automatically retiring only positively identified Workspaces plugin state is the intended beta upgrade policy, with Doctor proof attached before merge.

options.title: Retain a user-controlled transition
options.body: Require an export, explicit opt-in cleanup, or temporary migration notice if maintainers want beta users to preserve Workspaces data longer.

recommendation.title: Approve beta-only removal
recommendation.body: Confirm that automatically retiring only positively identified Workspaces plugin state is the intended beta upgrade policy, with Doctor proof attached before merge.
